class.name: OcgStdselectBrepowner
class.brief_description: Defines Specific Owners for Sensitive Primitives (Sensitive Segments,Circles...). Used in Dynamic Selection Mechanism. A BRepOwner has an Owner (the shape it represents) and Users (One or More Transient entities). The highlight-unhighlight methods are empty and must be redefined by each User.
class.description: ! Defines Specific Owners for Sensitive Primitives ! (Sensitive Segments,Circles...). ! Used in Dynamic Selection Mechanism. ! A BRepOwner has an Owner (the shape it represents) ! and Users (One or More Transient entities). ! The highlight-unhighlight methods are empty and ! must be redefined by each User.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Constructs an owner specification framework defined by the priority aPriority.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs an owner specification framework defined by the shape aShape and the priority aPriority. aShape and aPriority are stored in this framework. If more than one owner are detected during dynamic selection, the one with the highest priority is the one stored.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs an owner specification framework defined by the shape aShape, the selectable object theOrigin and the priority aPriority. aShape, theOrigin and aPriority are stored in this framework. If more than one owner are detected during dynamic selection, the one with the highest priority is the one stored.

method.name: HasShape
method.description: returns False if no shape was set

method.name: HasHilightMode
method.description: Returns true if this framework has a highlight mode defined for it.

method.name: SetHilightMode
method.description: Sets the highlight mode for this framework. This defines the type of display used to highlight the owner of the shape when it is detected by the selector. The default type of display is wireframe, defined by the index 0.

method.name: ResetHilightMode
method.description: Resets the higlight mode for this framework. This defines the type of display used to highlight the owner of the shape when it is detected by the selector. The default type of display is wireframe, defined by the index 0.

method.name: HilightMode
method.description: Returns the highlight mode for this framework. This defines the type of display used to highlight the owner of the shape when it is detected by the selector. The default type of display is wireframe, defined by the index 0.

method.name: IsHilighted
method.description: Returns true if an object with the selection mode aMode is highlighted in the presentation manager aPM.

method.name: Unhilight
method.description: Removes highlighting from the type of shape identified the selection mode aMode in the presentation manager aPM.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears the presentation manager object aPM of all shapes with the selection mode aMode.

method.name: UpdateHighlightTrsf
method.description: Implements immediate application of location transformation of parent object to dynamic highlight structure

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
